component.name: Ocio
component.summary: A Raylib eye-tracking application from the Packathon packaging project

description.p: Ocio is an interactive graphical application built in C with raylib. The window displays an eye whose pupil and iris smoothly follow the mouse cursor using organic saccadic damping.
Developed as part of the Packathon project to experiment with and document diverse software packaging and distribution formats:

ul.li: Native architecture binaries (Linux x86_64, Windows, macOS ARM)

description.p: Initial release of Ocio with gaze tracking, dynamic color themes, and multi-format packaging pipelines.
